name: hyniqe-hub
description: Hyniqe Hub: free, open-source tools for payment, treasury and securities operations data. Fix rejected payment files, convert bank statements, find duplicate payments and suppliers, triage returns, check SSIs and corporate actions, score data quality.

scripts.bench: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning solutions/ssi-checker/bench.ts --out out --min-recall 0.99 --max-false 0.01 && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning solutions/duplicate-payments/bench.ts --out out --min-recall 0.9 --min-precision-high 0.99 && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning solutions/payment-file-doctor/bench.ts --out out --min-detect 0.99 --min-repair 0.95 && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning solutions/corporate-actions-checker/bench.ts --out out --min-detect 0.99 && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning solutions/vendor-master-cleanup/bench.ts --out out --min-detect 0.99 && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning solutions/payment-returns-triage/bench.ts --out out && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning solutions/data-quality-scorecard/bench.ts --out out && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning solutions/bank-detail-change-check/bench.ts --out out --min-detect 0.99 && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning solutions/payment-message-explainer/bench.ts --out out && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning solutions/e-invoice-checker/bench.ts --out out && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning solutions/bank-reconciliation/bench.ts --out out --min-correct 0.99
scripts.prebuild:site: npm run -s bench && cd engine && npm run -s seed && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/benchmark.ts --set holdout --out out
